Renee (People Ops): Quick operational note: we're changing the review handoff priority this cycle to reduce late-stage chaos. Please read and update your handoff entries. :gear:
Omar (Manager): What changed exactly?
Renee (People Ops): TL;DR: handoffs will be queued by urgency + blackout windows. Urgency = time to final submit + promo flag. High-urgency gets auto-floater assignment within 4h.
Jules (Manager): How do we mark urgency in the tracker?
Renee (People Ops): Add one of these tags in the backfill column: `urgent`, `standard`, `promo`. `urgent` = <48h to submit, `promo` = any promotion or level-change note.
Kai (Eng): If someone is handing off mid-review, what's the minimal package we expect?
Renee (People Ops): Minimal handoff = one-line status + current draft comment + last 2 peer quotes + any open questions. Paste that into the backfill cell. Use this snippet: ```Handoff: status | draft link | peer1/peer2 | open Qs```
Sita (Recruiter): For conversion or hiring-impact promos, do we still need finance cleared before cross-org?
Renee (People Ops): Yes. Mark `promo` or `conversion` and attach the finance note. Ops will hold assignment until finance confirms (target SLA 24h).
Omar (Manager): Any change to redaction/audit rules? We sometimes need to remove sensitive peer comments.
Renee (People Ops): New rule: redact only personal-identifying language; do NOT redact evidence of performance. If you redact, add a 1-line redaction reason in the note (e.g., PII removed). People Ops will keep an unredacted copy in the audit bundle.
Jules (Manager): What about embargo + manager 1:1 timing?
Renee (People Ops): Manager 1:1s may start on 2026-04-15 09:00 UTC. DO NOT share final numeric ratings before that. You can share development feedback earlier, but not final outcomes.
OpsBot: Reminder: handoff tags guide + auto-floater rules posted in the tracker. Signups close in 72h. :bell:
Kai (Eng): If the auto-floater can't cover a high-urgency slot, what's the escalation path?
Renee (People Ops): Escalate to @people-ops with `urgent-fallback` and we'll manually assign a senior reviewer within 6h.
Sita (Recruiter): Will audit bundles include redaction logs? Finance sometimes requests that.
Renee (People Ops): Yes  audit bundles will contain both redaction logs and the unredacted master; request via the audit form (48h processing).
Omar (Manager): Thanks  updating my backfill cells now.
Renee (People Ops): Thanks all  we're aiming to cut late-stage rework. Ping us if you hit edge cases or need a buddy for first-time handoffs. :pray:
